insights.headline: Reported US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island flips the tone: oil's risk premium is back as gold holds near $3,950
insights.summary: A WSJ report of a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island reversed Monday's diplomacy-driven oil selloff: Brent rebounded 0.5% to $105.25 after settling 7.6% lower at $104.77. Gold consolidated near $3,950, holding Monday's 2%+ rebound from Friday's one-year low, ahead of Tuesday's US midterms. Silver hovered around $50 after Friday's $48.47 yearly low; MCX silver is down ~57% from its peak and the gold-silver ratio sits at 79. Fed funds futures still price ~70%+ odds of a December hike. MCX gold futures closed at Rs 1.40 lakh per 10 grams as jewellers reported reviving Dhanteras footfalls.
points: Brent rebounded 0.5% to $105.25 in Asian trade after Monday's 7.6% plunge; WTI rose to $96.93 on the Qeshm Island strike report.
Spot gold consolidated near $3,950 after Monday's 2%+ rebound from Friday's one-year low below $3,900.
Silver held around $50 after Friday's yearly low of $48.47; MCX silver is down ~57% from its peak, with the gold-silver ratio at 79.
CME FedWatch still implies ~70-75% odds of a December Fed rate hike, capping bullion's recovery.
MCX gold futures ended at Rs 1.40 lakh/10 gm; jewellers expect 10-12% higher Dhanteras sales volumes.

trending.title: The Iran trade flips overnight
trending.summary: Monday's diplomacy-driven oil selloff — Brent down 7.6% — was reversed by the WSJ report of US strikes on Qeshm Island, putting the risk premium back in focus ahead of the midterms.

trending.title: Silver's 60% round trip
trending.summary: Silver has wiped out nearly 60% since its ~$122 January record and sits around $50 in oversold territory, even as India clears a 6,500-tonne import pipeline into 2027.

trending.title: Dhanteras dip-buying revives
trending.summary: A 7% monthly slide in gold prices has brought Indian buyers back to jewellery stores, with jewellers expecting 10-12% higher Dhanteras sales volumes led by lightweight pieces.

trending.title: $4,000 is the line in the sand
trending.summary: Gold's recovery faces the $4,000 test with December Fed-hike odds above 70%; forecasters split on whether sub-$4,000 is a buying window or a stop before $3,500.

items.title: Oil rises after report of US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island
items.summary: WSJ reported, citing US officials, that US forces struck Iran's Qeshm Island on Monday — described as defensive strikes to protect shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Brent, which had settled 7.6% lower at $104.77 on US-Iran talk hopes, rebounded 0.5% to $105.25 in early Asian trade. The report put the risk premium — and gold's haven bid — back in focus ahead of Tuesday's US midterms.

items.title: Gold, silver rebound as Iran diplomacy sends oil lower, easing Fed tightening concerns
items.summary: Spot gold climbed 1.8% to about $3,946 an ounce and silver 3.7% to $50.94 on Monday as renewed US-Iran diplomacy pushed crude down more than 4%, easing inflation fears. Iran said it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume nuclear talks within two days; WTI fell below $100 and Brent toward $108.55. Kitco notes ~75% December Fed-hike odds still cap conviction.

items.title: Dip in gold price puts the sparkle back into festive and wedding buying, jewellers see 10-12% rise in Dhanteras sales
items.summary: A more than 7% slide in gold prices over the past month — ₹1.37 lakh per 10 gm in Mumbai spot trade, down from ₹1.48 lakh — has revived footfalls and advance bookings ahead of Dhanteras on November 6. IBJA national secretary Surendra Mehta expects Dhanteras sales volume to rise 10–12% year-on-year, with buyers favouring lightweight and lower-karat jewellery.

items.title: Gold price prediction: Will gold extend gains on Tuesday? Check outlook for November 3
items.summary: MCX gold futures ended at Rs 1.40 lakh per 10 grams after snapping a two-day losing streak, as a steep oil-price fall eased inflation fears. Spot gold edged 0.3% to $3,960.80 in Asian trade, holding Monday's 2%+ rebound. Prithvi Finmart's Manoj Kumar Jain expects choppy trade this week on crude, the dollar and geopolitics, pegging support at $3,940-3,880 an ounce.

items.title: Gold rises to near $3,950 as traders brace for US midterm election
items.summary: Gold pushed toward $3,950 in Asian trade Tuesday as a ~7% crude slide on ongoing US-Iran talks tempered inflation worries. Traders are positioning for the US midterms, with polls favoring Democrats to take the House; FXStreet notes renewed deficit fears could lift safe-haven demand. Peter Grant (Zaner Metals) said ~73% December Fed-hike odds (CME FedWatch), down from 80%, still cap conviction.

items.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD reclaims $50 as Oil tumbles, bearish trend holds
items.summary: Silver climbed back above $50, up about 3.8% on the day, after sliding to a fresh yearly low of $48.47 on Friday. The rebound follows a 5%+ drop in crude oil on positive US-Iran diplomatic signals. FXStreet keeps a bearish technical read with silver below its 21-day ($56), 100-day ($61) and 200-day ($70) SMAs: resistance at $52 then $55, support at Friday's low near $48.87.

items.title: Gold Faces $4,000 Test as December Hike Risk Caps the Recovery
items.summary: Spot gold rose $67.90 (+1.8%) to $3,945.70 on Monday, rebounding from Friday's 3.6% crash to $3,869.80, its lowest since October 2025. The bounce is driven by crude, not safe-haven demand: WTI fell 6.28% to $97.58 as Iran signaled it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The recovery faces the $4,000 test with December hike odds above 70%, CPI at 3.4% and Friday's jobs report looming.

items.title: Buy Gold Below $4,000 or Wait for $3,500?
items.summary: FXEmpire weighs buying gold below $4,000 against waiting for $3,500. The Gold & Silver Club's base case targets $4,900-$5,000 an ounce by Q1 2027; UBS projects $5,400 by September 2027 and calls pullbacks toward $4,000 a chance to add; RBC favours a $5,296 scenario for 2027. Against that, a slide to $3,500 would be another 12.5% pullback — but waiting risks missing recovery if gold turns first.

items.title: Gold (XAUUSD), Silver, Platinum Forecasts – Gold Rebounds As Oil Tumbles
items.summary: Gold rebounded after Friday's pullback as oil dropped 6.5% on Middle East headlines, with a weaker dollar adding support. FXEmpire flags resistance at $4,000–$4,020, then $4,100 and $4,180–$4,200, noting Fed funds futures imply a 74.9% chance of a December rate hike. Silver moved off yearly lows above $50, testing $51–$52 with $55 next; platinum challenges $1,440–$1,460.

items.title: Gold Rebound or Dead Cat Bounce? $4,000 Holds the Key
items.summary: Investing.com's Fawad Razaqzada calls gold's recovery fragile: $4,000 is now resistance after the break below, the $3,942-$4,000 zone is the key ceiling, and failure opens $3,800 then $3,700. Drivers: the sharp oil retreat easing inflation fears, building December Fed-hike odds, Tuesday's US midterms, a hawkish BoE Thursday, and Friday's payrolls.

items.title: India set to ramp up silver imports into 2027 as 6,500-tonne permits clear backlog
items.summary: Heraeus: India's easing silver-import regime should lift consumption over the next two quarters, with permits for ~6,500 tonnes (about 209 moz) over six months -- nearly 90% of 2025's total imports. Monthly imports fell to ~1 moz in May-June under licence rules, then recovered to 15.5 moz in August. Gold is also seeing renewed buying below $4,000, though Fed-hike bets still hang over the metal.

items.title: Gold, silver outlook: Why analysts remain cautious despite Monday's recovery
items.summary: Gold and silver staged a tentative rebound on MCX on Monday after Friday's 3.7% rout, with December gold futures near ₹1.38 lakh per 10 grams and spot gold up 0.6% to about $3,899 an ounce; silver rose 1.3% to $49.76. Analysts at Lemonn and Bonanza told CNBC TV18 it is too early to call a bottom — prices must stop printing lower daily lows and reclaim short-term moving averages first.

items.title: Gold's Global Rout Isn't Giving Indian Buyers Much Relief
items.summary: Global gold is down roughly 10% this year, but Indian buyers are seeing no relief: MCX spot gold is actually up about 3% in 2026, Bloomberg's India Edition notes. The culprit is the rupee's slide against the dollar, which has offset the global price decline for domestic buyers -- a 'gold divide' leaving Indians waiting for the rout to reach their jewellers.

items.title: Gold and Silver Rebound Ahead of Diwali; Silver Jumps Rs 3,500
items.summary: MCX December gold opened Rs 518 higher at Rs 1,39,003/10g and hit an intraday high of Rs 1,39,179, while December silver opened Rs 1,962 up at Rs 1,81,094 and reached Rs 1,82,701 - a Rs 3,569 rise - ahead of Dhanteras. Comex gold traded ~0.33% higher near $3,911.60, silver up 2.24% at $50.38; Choice Broking's Kaveri More cited a near-3% crude fall and festive demand.

items.title: Gold futures rise to Rs 1.38 lakh on strong spot demand
items.summary: Gold futures firmed on Monday as fresh speculative positions and firm spot demand lifted prices, analysts said — the December contract on MCX gained Rs 281 to Rs 1,38,766 per 10 grams, up about 0.2%, while gold futures in New York rose 0.83% to $3,906.81 an ounce. The advance came despite broader global pressure on gold earlier in the week.

items.title: Gold falls Rs 2,282/10 gm to Rs 1.38 lakh; silver down Rs 1,264 to Rs 1.80 lakh/kg
items.summary: Gold and silver fell ahead of Diwali on a stronger dollar, profit-booking at high prices and buyers holding back; silver also faced weak industrial demand and futures selling. IBJA rates eased: gold down Rs 2,282 to Rs 1.38 lakh/10g, silver down Rs 1,264 to Rs 1.80 lakh/kg — about Rs 2.06 lakh below its all-time high. Expert Ajay Kedia advises buying in instalments.

items.title: AMC's undercover buy leads to fake silver foil bust
items.summary: AMC health inspectors traced failed rapid-test sweets from a Memco-area handcart to H M Warakhwala, a Kalupur gold-and-silver-foil shop; an inspector's undercover buy failed the purity test and the shop was sealed. Officers seized 170 packets of fake silver foil (10 leaves each, Rs 250/packet; Rs 42,500 total) for lab testing — a caution for Diwali sweet buyers.

items.title: Gold is 20% off its peak this Dhanteras, but jewellery stocks know something buyers don't
items.summary: Gold sits about 20% below its January record ahead of Dhanteras on November 6, yet remains roughly 8% costlier than last year's Dhanteras, while most listed jewellers are still in the green for the year. Jewellers earn on sale value, not weight: Titan and Kalyan posted strong quarterly updates on studded jewellery and lighter designs. Spot gold fell about 4% on Friday to near $3,875 an ounce.

items.title: SGB 2021-22 Series VII investors set for 200%+ gains as RBI fixes premature redemption at Rs 14,167
items.summary: RBI has fixed the premature redemption price for Sovereign Gold Bond 2021-22 Series VII at Rs 14,167 per unit, with the early-exit window due on November 2, 2026 — five years after the tranche was issued at Rs 4,765 per gram (Rs 4,715 for online buyers). Investors redeeming now lock in an absolute capital gain of about 200.5%, over and above the 2.5% annual interest the bonds paid.

items.title: Gold's slide to one-year low: margin calls amplified a fall driven by Fed hike bets
items.summary: Gold's drop below $3,900 on Friday — more than 3% to a one-year low — was amplified by forced selling as a tech rout triggered margin calls, Commerzbank noted. Oil-fed inflation and ~70-75% odds of a December Fed hike remain the bigger drag; the bank expects metals to recover once leverage clears, with US jobs on Nov 6 and inflation on Nov 10 the next tests.

items.title: Dhanteras 2026 offers: Cashback on digital gold, discounts on jewellery making charges and more
items.summary: Ahead of Dhanteras (Nov 6), PhonePe offers 2% cashback up to Rs 2,000 on 24K digital gold buys of Rs 10,000+ (till Nov 8); BharatPe adds 5% extra digital gold above Rs 100 plus leaderboard prizes; Joyalukkas cuts making charges 50% till Nov 8; Senco's Dhanteras Shagun gives up to Rs 14,000/10g off gold jewellery and 36% off diamond value, with zero old-gold exchange deduction.

items.title: Muthoot Finance rebounds, up 9% from 52-week low as stock reacts to Q2 nos
items.summary: Shares of gold-loan major Muthoot Finance traded about 9% above their 52-week low, reacting to the company's second-quarter results. The rebound comes amid a sharp fall in gold prices that has kept the spotlight on lenders whose collateral values are tied to bullion.

items.title: Crash! Gold price suffers worst October in years: Did silver and platinum suffer too? Check monthly performance
items.summary: Mint's monthly review: gold logged its worst October in years, sinking to a one-year low near $3,876 an ounce, while silver and platinum suffered too — silver slipped below $50 for the first time in nearly a year and platinum hit a 13-month low. The piece traces the selloff to hot US inflation data, Fed rate-hike bets and a broader market rout.

items.title: Gold And Silver Prices See A Big Drop In October: Is Dhanteras The Right Time To Buy?
items.summary: News18's Business Desk recaps October's sharp MCX correction — gold futures fell nearly Rs 7,800 per 10 grams over the month while silver lost around Rs 44,840 per kg — framing the slide as pre-festive relief for buyers and asking whether the Dhanteras window makes this the right time to step in.

items.title: Silver Price Crash: 1 Kg Silver May Soon Equal 10 Grams of Gold as Gold-Silver Ratio Hits 79
items.summary: The gold-silver ratio has climbed to 79 from below 50 in January as silver's crash outpaced gold's. MCX silver is down about 57% from its Rs 4,20,048/kg peak to Rs 1,78,900; gold is down about 23% to Rs 1,38,419/10g. At these levels silver needs to fall another 22.6% — gold flat — for 1 kg to equal 10 grams of gold. Metals Focus sees silver supply easing into a 2027 surplus.

NDTV Profit calculates that Rs 1 lakh buys about 7.1 grams of 24-carat gold this Dhanteras — roughly 25% more than the ~5.7 grams it fetched at January's Rs 1,75,340 peak — with IBJA gold at Rs 1,40,054 per 10 grams on October 30. Gold is still ~8% costlier than last Dhanteras, and analysts favor staggered buying into the November 6 festival.
items.title: Your Rs 1 Lakh Buys 25% More Gold This Dhanteras Than In January. Should You Invest?
Dhanteras 2026: How To Check Gold Purity, Hallmarking And Making Charges
items.summary: Ahead of Dhanteras on November 6, Outlook Money walks buyers through checking gold purity via karat and fineness marks, verifying the three BIS hallmark signs including the six-digit HUID code, and scrutinising the bill for making charges, net weight and GST before paying.
